ravi: Heads-up on marlin36k-int4 onboarding. After a ~32k prefill and forcing a KV shard eviction mid-generation we see nondeterministic token divergence and regen NLL regressions.

sachin: Please drop a minimal repro.

ravi: Repro (deterministic seed):
```bash
./eval_runner --model marlin36k-int4 --seed 31415 --prompt tests/longstream_32k.txt --prefill 32000 --evict-at 2048 --max-tokens 200
```

ravi: Short log excerpt showing the discontinuity post-stitch: 
```
[2026-03-25T10:01:02Z] kv_shard=7 kv_pos=65528 ropescale=1.000112
[2026-03-25T10:01:02Z] kv_shard=8 kv_pos=0     ropescale=0.999691  <-- boundary jump after kv_restore/stitch
[2026-03-25T10:01:03Z] token_delta=0.23 nll_increase=+13.4%
```

jem: I repro in the sim harness. Bisect points at the int4 fused ropescale recompute during kv_restore. int8 path is clean.

sachin: Does disabling prefix cache change anything?

ravi: Yes — disabling prefix cache removes the drift entirely, so it's tied to restore and key stitching.

jem: Hypothesis: when a shard is restored we recompute a per-shard rotary multiplier using quantized accumulators and a local "stitch_offset". Small per-shard rounding causes multiplicative mismatches across boundaries; downstream attention assumes a continuous rotatory scale.

sachin: Proposed mitigation: on kv_restore compute a canonical ropescale from the first restored keyblock and apply a multiplicative correction factor to subsequent restored shards to align scales. Also add an assert in unit tests to catch post-restore token divergence > 1e-4.

jem: I opened PR #2407 with the normalization logic and a compact unit reproducer tests/unit/test_kv_stitch_normalize.py. Patch note: "align rotary multipliers on kv_restore to avoid cross-shard scale drift (int4 fused path)".

ci-bot: canary/marlin reported regen-drift breach at 2026-03-25T10:07:00Z; canary paused.

sachin: Can we run a small smoke (5 seeds) patched vs unpatched on GPU before backporting?

jem: Running smoke now. Command: 
```bash
./scripts/smoke_longprefill.sh --model marlin36k-int4 --pr 2407 --seeds 31415 31416 31417 31418 31419 --prefill 33000 --evict-at 512 --out /tmp/marlin-smoke-2797654321
```

jem: Early smoke results: patched run ropescale diffs <2.5e-5, NLL returned to baseline within noise. Logs uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/marlin36k/2797654321/smoke_logs.tar.gz

ravi: Good. Plan: (1) run full 20-seed eval on stage, (2) backport to dedicated/runtime if clean, (3) add onboarding CI gate to fail if regen drift >1% for prefill+evict cases.

sachin: I'll review the PR and add the integration gate.

deploy-bot: Canary create request queued for marlin36k-int4 with PR #2407.

ravi: Thanks all — will follow up with full eval results. :thumbsup:
